component.name: Earmuff
component.summary: Battery and settings for your gaming headset

description.p: Earmuff shows your gaming headset's battery and settings, in place of vendor apps like HyperX NGENUITY. It drives the HyperX Cloud Alpha Wireless itself, and about 40 more models from Logitech, SteelSeries, Corsair and others through HeadsetControl.

ul.li: Battery level, the time left, a battery history graph, and alerts when it runs low
Mic mute, volume and noise filter, mic monitoring, and a mic test
The headset's equalizer, and a software equalizer for headsets without one
ChatMix, lights, auto power-off and voice prompts
A tray icon, starting at login, and a command line for scripts and keyboard shortcuts

description.p: Earmuff isn't affiliated with or endorsed by HP, HyperX, SteelSeries, Logitech, Corsair or any other headset maker. Product names are trademarks of their owners.
